question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

One who is mentally not sound.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Lunatic"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **Let's see the meaning of other words-

 
 
• **Brainy**:- Having or showing intelligence. बुद्धिमान
 
• **Lunatic** :- a person who is mentally ill (not technical in use) पागलपन का आचरण करने वाला व्‍यकि्त
 
• **Miserly**:- the person who has the qualities of miser कृपण समान, कंजूसी-भरा
 
 
• **Miser** :- a person who spends money as little money as possible
 
 
 
• **Mindful** :- Conscious or aware of something.सावधान, सचेत, सतर्क, जागरुक
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **"Lunatic" **i.e. Option 2.
